_note: A scrubbed copy of a real launch board, kept as a worked example of the seed shape. Client name, personal names, private pricing, admin identity and internal domains were removed. To view it: paste this seed into board.html's <script id="seed"> block (or run: node build.js examples/nabshift.seed.json > nabshift.html).

tasks.title: Legal entity + EIN for the SMS sender
tasks.detail: The registered business that owns the SMS sender identity.

tasks.title: Site privacy + SMS-terms pages
tasks.detail: The marketing site carries the SMS program language the A2P registration points at.

tasks.title: Submit the A2P 10DLC campaign
tasks.detail: Brand + campaign registered with the SMS provider. Carrier vetting follows.

tasks.title: Carrier vetting clears
tasks.detail: Brand ~1 business day, campaign ~3–5 business days. Out of your hands — tap ✓ when the provider says approved.

tasks.title: Enable the phone auth provider
tasks.detail: The switch that flips real sign-in + outbound SMS from inert to live.

tasks.title: Outbound SMS sender function
tasks.detail: Real sender + message templates; retire the simulator for the pilot crew.

tasks.title: Verify real phone-OTP sign-in E2E
tasks.detail: First real login exercising the staged auth path end-to-end.

tasks.title: Staging port + verification
tasks.detail: Schema, access rules, write-path RPCs, snapshots, day claims — verified on staging.

tasks.title: Cross-account admin switcher
tasks.detail: Membership-verified switching, read-only cross-account view. Staging-verified.

tasks.title: Decide: shared vs dedicated prod project
tasks.detail: Decided: dedicated production project, shared across future clients.

tasks.title: Client production bootstrap
tasks.detail: Apply the bootstrap SQL to the chosen prod project.

tasks.title: Upgrade the DB plan
tasks.detail: Free tier auto-pauses after idle — must be on the paid plan before the pilot.

tasks.title: Mint the client admin identity
tasks.detail: Sign in once with the admin number and insert the admin row.

tasks.title: Deploy the login config to the app domain
tasks.detail: Ship the login-gated deploy; the public demo stays the sales demo.

tasks.title: Run the full SQL verify suites
tasks.detail: Day-claims, read-path, write-path, and instrumentation suites in the SQL editor.

tasks.title: Publish day claims to Realtime
tasks.detail: Add to the publication when the live board subscribes to day capacity.

tasks.title: PWA hardening + icon rebuild
tasks.detail: Manifest 192/512/maskable + iOS meta; full-bleed icon family.

tasks.title: Icon + install check on a real phone
tasks.detail: Add to Home Screen on iPhone + Android; eyeball the icon. Verified headless only so far.

tasks.title: DUNS number arrives
tasks.detail: Applied — typically 1–2 weeks. Tap ✓ the day the number lands.

tasks.title: Apple developer account
tasks.detail: Annual fee; needs the DUNS number.

tasks.title: Google Play developer account
tasks.detail: One-time fee; needs only the verified legal entity — no DUNS, unlike Apple.

tasks.title: Native wrapper + push
tasks.detail: A separate project from the web app. Later sprint.

tasks.title: Store submissions
tasks.detail: Reviewers sign in via a test OTP, so not blocked on live SMS. Budget one review bounce.

tasks.title: Pricing decided
tasks.detail: One flat all-in monthly.

tasks.title: Crew onboarding kit
tasks.detail: Worker/admin quickstarts + SMS cheat sheet.

tasks.title: Pricing conversation with the client
tasks.detail: Pricing meeting happened and went well.

tasks.title: Counsel: policy block + agreement review
tasks.detail: Review the draft pilot agreement and the contractor policy.

tasks.title: Pilot agreement signed
tasks.detail: Fill the bracketed entity/date placeholders and get ink.

tasks.title: Crew + gigs intake sheets
tasks.detail: The client's real roster + gigs; confirm the real office/SMS number.

tasks.title: First real data load
tasks.detail: Intake CSV → load SQL → the client's crew + gigs in the prod DB.

tasks.title: Vendor entity registered
tasks.detail: Your own legal entity (distinct from the client's) — unblocks the agreement + payment.

tasks.title: Live verification pass
tasks.detail: Full smoke, live OTP login, leak probes, both channels. Nothing is live before this.

tasks.title: Roll out to the pilot crew
tasks.detail: Quickstarts in hand, crew installing + claiming for real.

tasks.title: PILOT LIVE
tasks.detail: Paying client, real crew, real shifts. The terminus. 🎉

tasks.title: Sprint-0 demo suite
tasks.detail: Pay visibility, assignment, locks + approvals, restricted eligibility, photos, branding — demoed.

tasks.title: Single-day claims on recurring posts
tasks.detail: Per-date capacity, penalty-free per-day drops; live on demo + staging.

tasks.title: GPS check-in + photo capture
tasks.detail: Spec landed; build in flight.

tasks.title: Server-side check-ins + admin map
tasks.detail: Server-timestamped check-ins are live on staging — remaining work is the admin-map render layer.

tasks.title: Photos → object storage
tasks.detail: Off localStorage thumbnails before anyone uploads full-size originals.

tasks.title: Trade approval v2
tasks.detail: Named, qualified replacement; swap executes only on admin approval.

tasks.title: Buy + auth sending domains & mailboxes
tasks.detail: Sending domains + mailboxes with SPF/DKIM/DMARC and one-click unsubscribe. Warmup starts after.

tasks.title: Domain / mailbox warmup (2–4 wks)
tasks.detail: The long pole of email — runs on its own clock once started.

tasks.title: Sequencer + CRM + territory split
tasks.detail: Pick a sequencer + CRM, suppression list, monitoring, and a scheduling link; agree the territory split.

tasks.title: Build the lead lists
tasks.detail: Start with the public licensee list for the local beachhead; national list behind it.

tasks.title: Enrich + verify the lists
tasks.detail: Contacts, emails, verification passes — before anything sends.

tasks.title: Write + internally test sequences
tasks.detail: A few sequences, tested against your own inboxes only. No cold sends yet.

tasks.title: Work the local warm list by hand
tasks.detail: Founder-led, personal, research-heavy — never a blast; the local market is tiny and precious.

tasks.title: Pilot case study — the proof numbers
tasks.detail: A real pilot read with named results. No cold outbound until this exists.

tasks.title: Cold sends live
tasks.detail: The sequencer turns on, armed with real proof numbers. Low volume; scale only as reply quality + deliverability hold.
